Untrusted content: get_playground_apis, get_provider, find_operations, get_openapi, get_provider_onboarding, dispute_finding, watch_listing, request_check, check_status, register_agent · Private data: get_prices, get_api, get_provider, get_tag, get_industry, find_estates, get_provider_estate, get_region, get_area, find_extensions, get_extension, find_ratings, find_cohorts, get_cohort, tag_group_tags, cohort_rankings, cohort_scores, find_operations, deprecated_operations, cohort_failures, compare_cohorts, find_agent_readiness, find_capabilities, get_capability, get_capability_edges, whats_changed, find_rating_movers, claim_listing, generate_artifact, watch_listing, request_check, export_dataset, export_stack, find_company_insights, vc_portfolio, save_search, my_workspace, create_list, find_apis_json · Public sink: get_tag, find_operations, cohort_failures, agent_readiness_dimensions, find_capabilities, gap_analysis, claim_listing, generate_artifact, submit_artifact, dispute_finding, watch_listing, request_check, export_dataset, submit_feedback · Destructive: get_prices, find_regulations, find_tag_groups, get_agent_readiness, save_search, list_saved_searches, run_saved_search, delete_saved_search, delete_list, find_postman.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
